FILE: app/services/magic_link_service.rb
# frozen_string_literal: true

class MagicLinkService
  def call(user)
    Success(user)
  end
end

FILE: config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
  namespace :api do
    namespace :v1 do
      post "auth/magic_link", to: "auth/magic_links#create"
    end
  end
end

## What this does

Adds the magic link service.
